Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim documentation. Can you
confirm you're comfortable continuing?
A: Yes, that's fine.
Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened.
A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Katy, Texas, in the right lane. Traffic was moving normally bfeore
that.
Q: What happened next?
A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind, and my head snapped forward and then back
against the seat.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle right away?
A: Yes, I got out and checked the car. The rear bumper was pushed in and the trunk wouldn't close properly.
Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?
A: He said he was looking at his phone and didn't see the light change back to green. He seemed apologetic.
Q: How are you feeling physically now?
A: My lower back is sore and stiff, especially when I sit for a long time or get out of bed in the morning. I've been
taking over-the-counter pain relievers and using a heating pad.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider about it?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me instructions for
stretching and rest. I'm scheduled for a follow-up next week.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I'm trying to keep up with work, but I've had to take a few shifts off because of the pain. I'd like to know
what the next steps are for my repair and medical claims.
Q: Thank you. I'll follow up with you by mail with those details. Have a good day.
A: Thanks, you too.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any

- "reason": one short sentence.
